answer: Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the lotus is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
